learningObjectives: Explain the challenges of managing shared application state.
Use Context API concepts to share state across components.
Choose suitable state management approaches for different application needs.

activities.title: State Architecture Map
activities.instruction: Map local and shared state across components.

content.concept: Application state can be local to a component or shared across multiple parts of an interface.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Context Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of a Context API setup.

content.concept: React Context provides a way to make shared values available to components without passing props through every level.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: State Strategy Selector
activities.instruction: Select the appropriate state strategy for each case.

content.concept: State placement should match the scope and update requirements of the data being managed.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Context Provider Builder
activities.instruction: Build a shared state structure using providers and consumers.

content.concept: A provider supplies shared context values while consuming components access those values where needed.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
